_comment: Ground-truth FLAT solve of the 19-node fine HeteroTaperedCluster (no abstraction). Copy-free LP AllToAll. num_chunks is the PER-GPU count (1): the scheduler scales it up by the number of participating GPUs (A4+B4+C6 = 14) when building the alltoall solver (scheduler.get_solver), giving one distinct chunk per ordered GPU pair. Compare against the hierarchical coarse solve (hierarchy_coarse_solve_hetero alltoall lp), whose coarse volume is |U|*|V|. Settings mirror the coarse driver: SLOWEST_LINK epoch, ONE_SHOT.
